Maria: Heads up — after the terraform change that enabled proxy protocol on the NLB for inference-gateway, some pods behind the NodePort started failing health checks and we saw 502s from the LB. Logs show TLS handshake errors coming from the readiness probe path.
Aj: ugh. do we have the service/target group config? sounds like probe/target protocol mismatch or proxy-proto off for the pod shim.
Maria: here's the service & TG snippets we're using:

Service:
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: inference-gw
  annotations:
    service.beta.kubernetes.io/aws-load-balancer-proxy-protocol: '*',
spec:
  type: NodePort
  ports:
    - name: https
      port: 443
      targetPort: 8443
  selector:
    app: inference-gateway
```

Terraform target group:
```hcl
resource "aws_lb_target_group" "inference_gw" {
  name     = "inference-gw-tg"
  port     = 443
  protocol = "TLS"
  target_type = "instance"
  health_check {
    protocol = "HTTP"
    path     = "/healthz/readiness"
    port     = "traffic-port"
  }
}
```

Sam: aha — health check is HTTP but TG is TLS and service forwards to 8443 (tls). NLB proxy protocol means source IP is prefixed to TCP stream; if the pod expects TLS client hello but ALB/TG is doing TLS termination or TLS passthrough mismatch, handshake fails. Two quick safe options: 1) make TG protocol TCP and let the pod do TLS (health check on TCP or HTTP via port 8443 with TLS passthrough), or 2) change health_check.protocol to HTTPS (TLS) and ensure path supports TLS health checks.

Aj: also check that the kube-proxy/nodeport isn't doing envoy sidecar mishap; any podAffinity/hostPort or proxy sidecars?

Maria: we do have a sidecar (istio) on this namespace for now. That could be the trick — sidecar intercepting traffic means probe arrives transformed. Should we flip TG to TCP first to stop TLS decoding?

Sam: yes flip TG to TCP and set health check port to traffic-port + type TCP. Example TF tweak:
```hcl
protocol = "TCP"
health_check {
  protocol = "TCP"
}
```
That should avoid TLS handshake errors. Then test readiness. If that fixes, we can later evaluate using TLS TG + HTTPS healthcheck if we want ALB TLS handling.

Maria: doing a small canary change now, will push in ~15m. pinging @Aj for review before apply.
Aj: lgtm, quick nit — remove `service.beta...proxy-protocol: '*'` annotation unless we actually parse proxy-protocol headers in the pods; proxy-protocol can break TLS if not expected.

infra-bot: deploy-check: plan for infra/inference-gw-tg succeeded in 3s, no destructive changes flagged. :white_check_mark:
Maria: thanks — I'll run `apply` after CI finishes and post results here. :thumbsup:
